property: DHCP directly reuses the BOOTP message/relay/bootstrap architecture while adding reusable address leases and a broader host-configuration state machine/options model.

date_or_range.notes: BOOTP RFC 951 through DHCP RFC 1531/1541/2131 lineage.

sources.supports: DHCP is based on BOOTP, preserves relay/interoperation, and adds leases/configuration

negative_claims: This edge does not imply DHCP is byte-for-byte BOOTP with extra options.
This edge does not imply all BOOTP implementations became DHCP implementations.
RARP and other bootstrap mechanisms remained relevant in some environments.
open_questions: Trace the option-format and relay-agent implementation genealogy.
notes: One of the strongest direct derivation edges in the archive because RFC 1531 explicitly states DHCP is based on BOOTP.
